title: Everyday Phrases — First Day at Work
scene_zh: 上班第一天 · 情境對話
title_quote: Today is my first day at work.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💼 實用上班第一天必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — First Day at Work
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用上班第一天情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從出門報到、領設備設密碼、開會認團隊，到下班交卡覆盤，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多職場場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical First Day at Work phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the commute, reception, IT setup, team meetings and the first evening wrap-up. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today is my first day at work.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ɪz maɪ fɜrst deɪ ət wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 今天是我上班的第一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope I am not late.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel so nervous this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe slowly, you will be okay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I bring everything I need?
dialogue.zh: 該帶的東西我都帶了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your ID, the papers, your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our office is far from home.
dialogue.zh: 我們辦公室離家挺遠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes thirty minutes by bus.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How early should I show up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, you slept badly last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our floor is the twelfth one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there security at the door?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show the guard your ID.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many floors does it have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty floors in total, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I am new here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！請問你叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please sign in at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I get a badge today?
dialogue.zh: 我今天會領到識別證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They will print one for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She handles all the first-day paperwork.
dialogue.zh: 報到的文件都是她在處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my ID and a copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ aɪˈdi ənd ə ˈkɑpi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that was fast and easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this card opens the doors?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wear it around your neck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, like this on the string?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you are all set now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這樣就沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, this coffee machine looks confusing.
dialogue.zh: 哇，這咖啡機看起來好複雜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just press the big green button.
dialogue.zh: 按那個大的綠色按鈕就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I eat at my desk?
dialogue.zh: 我可以在座位上吃飯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bad luck, the water cooler is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd lʌk, ðə ˈwɔtər ˈkulər ɪz ˈɛmpti./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I look too dressed up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 放輕鬆，你看起來很專業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 明天你可以穿輕鬆一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋子把腳磨得好痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a jacket required every day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 弄鬆一點，沒人會在意的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You made it, that is what counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ɪt, ðæt ɪz wʌt kaʊnts./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is down to ten percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz daʊn tu tɛn pərˈsɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 我手機只剩百分之十的電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are outlets under the desks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, the card reader blinked red twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps, ðə kɑrd ˈridər ˈblɪŋkt rɛd twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，讀卡器紅燈閃了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I almost took the wrong elevator.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the floor list before pressing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our elevator was packed this morning.
dialogue.zh: 今早電梯擠得水洩不通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stairs keep you awake anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I allowed to sit here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything feels strange on day one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon it will feel completely normal.
dialogue.zh: 很快就會覺得稀鬆平常了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I walked past the wrong desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That happens to everyone at first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heads up, the building closes at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛdz ʌp, ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈkloʊzəz ət ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 提醒你，大樓七點就閉門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my friend visit at noon?
dialogue.zh: 我朋友中午可以來找我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a printer blocks the hallway.
dialogue.zh: 你看，有台印表機擋住走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我已經喜歡這間辦公室了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I wait for the bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ weɪt fər ðə bʌs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stop is by the east gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɑp ɪz baɪ ði ist ɡeɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You walked into the west one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can ask the guard next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn æsk ðə ɡɑrd nɛkst taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 剛剛好，先到樓下買杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But my card stopped working on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt maɪ kɑrd stɑpt ˈwɜrkɪŋ ɑn mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Front desk keeps spare cards for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌnt dɛsk kips spɛr kɑrdz fər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 櫃台有備用門卡可以換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cab got stuck in traffic.
dialogue.zh: 我的計程車塞在半路上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am heading in now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: HR will meet you at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪtʃ ɑr wɪl mit ju ət tɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 薪資那一欄要核對清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your tax form needs an address.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I fill it out tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, direct deposit needs bank details.
dialogue.zh: 可以，自動轉帳需要銀行資訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have my card number here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Adjust the monitor to your height.
dialogue.zh: 把螢幕調到適合的高度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little lower and it is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ˈloʊər ænd ɪt ɪz faɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set a password to log in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 字母、數字和符號混著用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I use a short phrase?
dialogue.zh: 我可以用一個短句子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, I will type it privately.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, our wifi needs a password.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do I find the code?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is on a note by the printer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn ə noʊt baɪ ðə ˈprɪntər./
dialogue.zh: 寫在印表機旁的便條上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is your name and a number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz jʊr neɪm plʌs ə ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 是你的名字加上一個編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reset links go to your email.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我的收件匣已經能用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it in the app store?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 資訊部今天就能幫你裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, because this laptop feels slow.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這台筆電有點慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lock your screen when you stand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 按 Control 加 L 就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個角落就是你的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這張椅子看起來很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the drawer lock still works.
dialogue.zh: 你看，抽屜的鎖還很好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will store my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I need a good neighbor.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我需要位好鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On your left sits our intern.
dialogue.zh: 你左手邊坐的是我們的實習生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們共用一台大印表機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do I put the paper?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paper lives in that tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy enough, I will load it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi ɪˈnʌf, aɪ wɪl loʊd ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不難，我現在把紙放進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask me if logging in fails.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Near the window, the wifi drops.
dialogue.zh: 靠近窗邊的地方常常斷網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the cable inside the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Am I allowed to edit them?
dialogue.zh: 我可以修改那些檔案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們這台印表機特別怕星期五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It jams at least twice a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʒæmz ət list twaɪs ə wik./
dialogue.zh: 一個星期至少卡紙兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Report issues to the help desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last digits of your number.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the desk phone keeps beeping.
dialogue.zh: 你聽，桌上電話一直嗶嗶響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the receiver to stop it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 耳機可以隔絕背景噪音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that would help a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Storage lockers are down the hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can keep my lunch there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Help yourself, the stationery box is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛlp jʊrˈsɛlf, ðə ˈsteɪʃəˌnɛri bɑks ɪz fri./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I can take what I need?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kæn teɪk wʌt aɪ nid?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 超過五十塊的尤其要留收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在覺得準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My boss will stop by later.
dialogue.zh: 我們主管待會兒會過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is she easy to talk to?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很好，我喜歡條理分明的主管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come, I will take you in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我雙腿都有點發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is set for the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big one with glass walls?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I say a few words?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name, role, and one fun fact.
dialogue.zh: 說名字、職位，再加一件有趣的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep it very short.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi everyone, pleased to meet you.
dialogue.zh: 大家好，很高興認識你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這個團隊看起來很和善。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me explain the team roles.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這對我很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And who looks after the budget?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw him by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do the tickets come from?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They land in one shared queue.
dialogue.zh: 全都匯進同一個佇列裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, just observe this week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old files live in the drive.
dialogue.zh: 舊檔案都放在共用硬碟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 從上個季度的企劃看起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 標了定稿的才是最新版。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I will note that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finally, some real work to do.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Collect data for the launch page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do we have a source file?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many rows should I check?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 確切的截止時間是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good tip, I will follow it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在這裡真的可以隨便問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們寧可你問，也不要亂猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I wrote down some already.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我已經寫下了幾個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 遇到問題不要一個人死撐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 在行事曆上圈出一段時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, protect at least two hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我的曆上已經排了一場會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Decline if it is not needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 新人那樣會不會沒禮貌？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有禮地拒絕完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the project board for priorities.
dialogue.zh: 優先順序都排在專案看板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 做完就把你的卡片移過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We kept notes from that call.
dialogue.zh: 那通開會我們有做記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I read them right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will send the link over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I will skim it first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你一入職就趕上旺季了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope to catch up fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每個人都曾走過第一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look how much you know now.
dialogue.zh: 你看你已經懂那麼多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 跟我們這群人一起吃吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the team usually go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 樓下那間簡餐店很便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for my own lunch?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ fər maɪ oʊn lʌntʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 我自己的午餐要付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will stay on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the whole team eats together.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，整個團隊一起用餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那裡的三明治超大一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a sandwich fills me up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rita asked me to join hiking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 午餐讓一天都輕鬆起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rest of the day flies.
dialogue.zh: 剩下的時間一下就過完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, but Dan made me laugh.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, bʌt dæn meɪd mi læf./
dialogue.zh: 還沒人邀，不過丹把我逗樂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A walk would wake me up.
dialogue.zh: 走一走能讓我清醒一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The walk worked, the afternoon flew by.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔk wɜrkt, ði ˌæftərˈnun flu baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 散步果然有效，下午一下就過完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later the boss asked for updates.
dialogue.zh: 後來主管要聽進度回報。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For you or the whole team?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我卡住的地方午飯後解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, say the task is done.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，就說任務完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 幾分鐘後就收到她的回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We saved a demo call for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi seɪvd ə ˈdɛmoʊ kɔl fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 我們存了一通示範電話給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do they talk to clients?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們的話術腳本樣樣都包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Team files are open to all.
dialogue.zh: 團隊檔案大家都看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will store mine there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每天晚上把桌面收整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the drawer key with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Report it to HR that day.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈpɔrt ɪt tu eɪtʃ ɑr ðæt deɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap out at the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I sign a log out?
dialogue.zh: 還要在登記表上簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just tap it and say goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the ride home I texted.
dialogue.zh: 回家的路上我傳了訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Most names match a face now.
dialogue.zh: 大部分名字都對上臉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 比我第一份工作強多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did Rita show you her templates?
dialogue.zh: 麗塔有給你看她的範本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and our boss kept her word.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd aʊr bɔs kɛpt hɜr wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 有，我們主管也說到做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每個答案都讓工作更明白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 第二天感覺比較不嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 習慣本身就是一種安慰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The coffee machine knows me now.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡機現在算認識我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我找到了那個安靜角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 適合要讀很多文件的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My notes and the first draft.
dialogue.zh: 我的筆記和第一版草稿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep those notes somewhere safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 過完今天要好好睡一覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One day down, many to go.
dialogue.zh: 第一天結束了，後面還有許多天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在好好休息，你應得的。
